facts.conditions: Partial hours round up. A server continues to incur charges while it exists, even when switched off; deleting it ends server billing. This is paid usage, not a discount or free trial.

facts.conditions: General Terms section 12 provides cancellation within 14 days of contracting by clear notice. Refunds are due within 14 days of receipt of that notice; services already started are charged pro rata. The same page includes additional US terms that take precedence where they conflict. This is not a promise of cost-free usage.
facts.label: Terms: section 12 and US special terms

faq.question: Is there a verified Hetzner promo code here?
faq.answer: No public, usable promo code was verified in the official pages reviewed for this guide. No code is published here.

faq.question: Can I still use an old referral credit link?
faq.answer: The official FAQ says the referral program has ended and old links no longer allow participation.

faq.question: Does switching off a Cloud server stop billing?
faq.answer: No. Charges continue while the server exists. Deleting a server does not remove separately billed resources such as Primary IPv4 addresses.

faq.question: Is the cancellation policy a free trial?
faq.answer: No. The general cancellation terms charge proportionally for services already started; check the applicable general and US special terms before ordering.
